name: Indwelling Devil

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target is dazed until the end of the indwelling devil’s next turn and grabbed

powers.name: Devil's Thrall
powers.requirements: usable only against a target dazed and grabbed by the indwelling devil

powers.name: Indwelling
powers.requirements: usable only against a target dominated and grabbed by the indwelling devil

hit.description: the indwelling devil merges with the target, sharing its space and controlling its actions. The merged creature is stunned until the merge ends. On the indwelling devil’s turn, it uses its actions to control the merged creature. It can choose only actions normally available to the target, and can use only the target’s at-will powers. A successful grab attack against the indwelling devil ends the merge. When the merge ends, the attacker slides the indwelling devil to a square adjacent to the creature it merged with, and the indwelling devil is dazed (save ends)

effect.description: The indwelling devil becomes invisible until the end of its next turn, or, if it is merged with a creature, it becomes invisible until the merge ends. The indwelling devil can end the invisibility as a free action.
